plan.name: Resolve captured Go acceptance selections
plan.summary: Add a host-selected Go acceptance adapter that validates captured direct go test arguments before any preparation, narrows a provably inclusive local package scope, preserves supported command policy, and escapes and anchors every literal selector component; document and explicitly refuse all other forms. Add production discovery through the prepared offline Go toolchain and wire its optional discovery boundary into the existing lifecycle: verify the pinned file's inclusion and bytes, one valid top-level testing declaration across ordinary and external tests, actual package identity and compilation, returning bound discovery or structured refusal/setup information without claiming that a subtest exists or that acceptance completed. Keep private staging, deepest ownership, captured source and execution authority, the original whole-run allowance, the shared test-phase allowance for discovery and compilation, and bounded cleanup; use real Go processes with standard-library temporary modules and isolated caches in default tests, and preserve the existing fake-adapter contracts. Keep default adapters, configured planning admission and external plumbing disabled, leave pytest/Vitest/Jest unsupported by production adapters, preserve legacy runners, hashes and locks, and leave runtime evidence collection and compiler-failure qualification to the subsequent issues. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations and docs/factory.md with the API, exact supported commands, refusal reasons and remaining runtime restriction, adjust the README's brief availability statement within its 400-line limit, and have the merger record the new selection/discovery decision before the next issue because this build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceCapturedSelection
tests.says: Supported captured commands retain their policy, narrow only inclusive local scopes and pass independently anchored literal selector components as arguments.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceUnsafeCommandsStopBeforePreparation
tests.says: Unsupported, ambiguous, conflicting, repeating or unsafe command forms are refused with reasons before dependency preparation or workload execution.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceRealToolchainDiscovery
tests.says: Real Go discovery and compilation identify the pinned declaration in root and nested packages, ordinary and external tests and tagged files without running test code or confusing identical names elsewhere.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceWrongFileAndAmbiguousDiscovery
tests.says: Wrong-file, excluded, malformed, duplicated and multiply matching declarations cannot produce a discovered selection.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceDiscoverySetupAndInterruption
tests.says: Missing tools, unresolved offline dependencies, invalid module discovery and cancellation return structured setup information and no selection or completion claim.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceLifecycleDiscoversWithoutCompleting
tests.says: The captured lifecycle discovers verbatim staged Go sources in a prepared environment while retaining ownership and bindings and refusing completion without a runtime collector.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptanceDiscoveryUsesSharedAllowances
tests.says: Command validation consumes the original allowance and discovery inherits the one shared test deadline, whether a suite or discovery starts that phase.

tests.name: TestGoAcceptancePreparedContainerBoundary
tests.says: The production prepared-container boundary exposes confined regular source reads and literal Go arguments with offline environment, working directory and isolation intact.
